title: File:Lunar South Pole Region (moon-background).png
desc: Artist’s rendering of the lunar South Pole region highlighting permanently shadowed areas that may preserve water ice deposits. These regions are considered important targets for future scientific study and sustained lunar exploration.

title: File:Lunar South Pole Illumination with Earth and Sun (SVS5228).jpg
art: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio - USRA/Ernie Wright, ADNET Systems, Inc./Laurence Schuler, ADNET Systems, Inc./Ia
desc: An animated view of the Earth and Sun as seen from near the Moon's South Pole.

title: File:Lunar South Pole - Out of the Shadows (LROC98).png
desc: As the Moon heads into southern summer the region around the south pole is better seen by LROC. One of the many goals of the LRO mission is to improve our cartographic knowledge of the Moon. The location of the pole shown here (image 1600 meters wide) may be in error by several hundred meters, wait

title: File:Lunar South Pole Terrain in Coded Color (SVS5127 - lola sp 0570 print).jpg
art: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio - USRA/Ernie Wright, Global Science and Technology, Inc./Alex Kekesi, Advocates i
desc: The camera flies toward and then around the Moon's South Pole as the natural surface color changes to colors that encode elevation. Thirty features at the South Pole are identified.

title: File:The Lunar South Pole (LROC237 - SP Mosaic 400m grid1).png
desc: LROC Wide Angle Camera (WAC) mosaic of the south polar region, width ~600 km [NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University].

title: File:The Lunar South Pole (LROC237 - SP Mosaic 400m label).png
desc: WAC south polar mosaic showing locations of major craters. The impact site of the LCROSS spacecraft is marked with an "X". Mosaic width is ~600 km [NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University].

title: File:Lunar South Pole Terrain in Coded Color (SVS5127 - lola sp still 4k).tiff
art: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio - Ernie Wright, Alex Kekesi, Noah Petro, David Ladd, Ian Jones, Laurence Schuler
desc: An image of the Moon's South Pole colored by elevation, with labels for 29 craters and the recently named Mons Mouton.
